content: A problem with learning directly from recorded dialogue corpora is that the state space that was visited during the collection of the data is limited; the size of the recorded corpus usually falls short of the requirements for training a statistical DM. However, even if the size of the corpus is large enough the optimal dialogue strategy is likely not to be contained within it.
